22.why: B is the hedged 'may diverge more' claim; D is its absolute overshoot ('always inaccurate'), C the passive-decay contrary, A a reversed correlation.

24.why: A is the 'reinforce rather than revise' counterintuitive qualification; B is the deficit-model contrary, C the optimistic version, D an absolute ('no power to change anyone's mind').
